description: Pylones RTE INSPIRE is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by portailsig.iservices.rte-france.com. Reference point geographical layer in Lambert 93, resulting from a monthly extraction of Infoligne (internal heritage base), and representative of all the supports of each of the existing overhead lines, from its point of origin to its terminal point. Coverage: FR. Its keywords include RTE, TRES HAUTE TENSION, HAUTE TENSION, RESEAU, INSPIRE, ELECTRICITE. The listing shows 2020-12-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
